queries_run: Mastercard distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026
Mastercard business model transition platform agentic commerce 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 描述 Mastercard 的數位授權與驗證能力橫跨店內、電商與 agentic 介面等所有數位通路，並列出數位錢包、BNPL 等 fintech 為競爭來源（通路擴張與競爭並存）
findings.excerpt: We offer global digital enablement and authentication capabilities that operate across all digital channels including in-store environments, e-commerce platforms and agentic interfaces.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出 fintech 與新興支付業者可能以內部帳戶轉帳、即時帳戶對帳戶網路等非卡軌處理支付，對客戶與資料構成競爭
findings.excerpt: we face increasing competition from fintechs and other emerging payments providers, both for customers and data.

findings.claim: Mastercard 推出 Agent Suite，協助企業部署內建支付與安全控制的 AI agent
findings.excerpt: Mastercard launches Agent Suite as the agentic AI era reshapes digital commerce • Mastercard introduces Mastercard Agent Suite to help businesses integrate agentic AI into their operations

findings.claim: 2026 年累計重組費用 2.02 億美元，目的為支持長期成長機會的再投資
findings.excerpt: Restructuring charge •In the nine months ended September 30, 2026, we recorded a restructuring charge of $202 million ($158 million after tax, or $0.18 per diluted share). The savings from the restructuring action are primarily intended to enable reinvestment to support the realization of our long-term growth opportunities.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋摘要僅得二手轉述（agentic 通路佔比、BVNK 收購、Agent Suite、2026 年重組費用），未讀到可逐字複製原文，列為 clues；未找到訂閱化／D2C 式的結構性轉移證據。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
